title: spec(migrations): two step-18 D3 entries still tell authors to rename "a single-brace token in a value position" — no value position reads one since #19939 S6, and the text ships in the upgrade guide and `spec-changes.json`
body:
Filing gate: **(a) author-facing text that prescribes a dead spelling**, under the release-text exception: the text ships in `@objectstack/spec` (`dist/migrations/index.js`, `index.mjs` and `spec-changes.json`, read in the 18.0.0-next.0 tarball by the #23261 dev), and GA ships it unless fixed before the cut. `reach:` the upgrade guide and `spec-changes.json` that an upgrading author or agent reads. Source: the #23261 dev report (out-of-scope finding 2, PR #23336). Reader who acts: triage, to grade and route (`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/`, `domain:spec`); then the owning seat.

Filed by `domain:spec` seat 2 (#18549) · `os-justin` · session `session_01BRQ9Mp1yH7R1az6MaUM18H`, at the review of PR #23336. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What is false

Two ADR-0087 D3 entries still tell the author to "rename every read of the old name with it — a text-slot hole, a CEL expression, **a single-brace token in a value position**":

- `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.flow-binding-name-dollar-refused.ts` (`replacement`, about `:35`);
- `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.flow-binding-variable-dollar-name-refused.ts` (`replacement`, about `:28`).

Since #19939's S6 (`615c69604`, CRUD filter operands) and S7 (`7958bdf36`, the resolver deleted), no value position reads a single-brace token: every value slot is a CEL envelope or a literal, and the `{…}` token is refused there. The two entries' changesets (22572 / 22502) were corrected by PR #23252, but the registry entries themselves were not.

## Wanted

- Both `replacement` texts name only the reads that exist on protocol 18 (a text-slot hole and a CEL expression), so the generated upgrade guide and `spec-changes.json` say the same as the corrected changesets.
- A `@objectstack/spec` patch changeset with the FROM → TO sentence; no schema or door change.
- A grep of the other step-18 entries for the same phrase, each hit fixed or named.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on this repo, closed included: `flow-binding-name-dollar-refused replacement single-brace token in a value position D3 registry rationale stale` → 6 hits. #22572 (closed) is the card these entries came from; #19939 and #22110 (closed) are the retirements that made the phrase false; #19992, #18101 and #16405 are unrelated. None is this.

Dedupe words: flow-binding-name-dollar-refused replacement single-brace token in a value position; D3 registry rationale stale S6; spec-changes.json single-brace.
